context.passage:
MEMO
To:
All Staff
From: Maintenance
Date: Monday, March 9
Because of a delay in the delivery of some materials, repairs to the roof
will not be made today. The work has been postponed until Thursday,
March 12.
As previously noted, the building will remain fully accessible while the
repairs are being made. However, you may experience some distractions
from the sound of power tools and maintenance workers overhead.
Because we are in a slow period in our production cycle, we expect the
impact to be minimal.
Thank you for your cooperation as we ensure that our building is a safe
and comfortable place to work. Please contact the maintenance department
directly with any questions.

choices: To seek input about needed repairs
To offer a reminder about workplace
